title: Derived extension of scalars preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\varphi\colon\cO_{E,X}\to E_X$ as in
[def-sfb-integers-to-subfield]. If $K\in D(\Mod_{\cO_{E,X}})$ is bounded constructible
[sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], then so is
$E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}K=L(\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi)(K)\in D(\Mod_{E_X})$
[sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars].

proof.text: Give the finite intermediate field E its norm induced by the fixed algebraic-closure embedding. The scalar-tower identity and multiplicativity of this norm give its normed-algebra structure over Q_ell. The valuation ring and inclusion used by the source declaration are then definitionally the continuous integral coefficients and scalar map. Apply integralScalarExtension_exact to obtain preservation of finite limits by the actual extension-of-scalars functor on X.

Apply boundedConstructible_leftDerivedExtendScalars_obj to this exact functor and the given bounded constructible complex. Its existing proof transports finite presentations on each original stratum and cover through scalar extension and uses the exact-functor homology comparison to preserve cohomological bounds. This is the general ring-object constructibility predicate of sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible; no comparison with finite constant local models is used.

proof_origin.place: Localization/flatness and exact homology preservation, implemented by specializing the already proved continuous scalar exactness and generic bounded constructibility theorem; C4 repair 2026-10-17
